gold_note: Ornithischian time tree. Branches read from the PDF's vector lines (1.0 pt), which drop the Abrictosaurus and one pachycephalosaur line; those parts were read by eye from a crop. The circled numbers 1-7 are caption keys (Ornithischia, Thyreophora, Cerapoda, Marginocephalia, Ceratopsia, Pachycephalosauria, Ornithopoda), not printed names, so no internal labels are encoded; ORNITHOPODA, printed at a line's end, is a tip. One four-way node: Prenocephale, Homalocephale, Stegoceras and Pachycephalosaurus. 33 tips, 1 polytomies (4 children). Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201). Topology read from the PDF's own vector branch lines and checked against the figure; topology only.
